title: Skill perks
description: data/skillPerks.json, and the workspace's skillPerks: each skill's milestone perks, keyed by skill id. Loaded by src/config/registries/perkRegistry.js (src/systems/hero/perkTable.js applies them); authored on the CMS's Skill Perks page (cms/src/components/perks/, cms/src/engine/skillPerks.js). The workspace may hold blank rows that Sync leaves out. Keys not listed here are reported as warnings.

id.description: The skill id, the same as its key.

level.description: The skill level that grants it (a whole number).

scale.description: How strong, a whole number 1 to 5.
